vacuityWarning: The PRE-EXISTING harness (test/invariant/PhlimboV3PromoInvariant.t.sol) uses MockStable as the promo token. MockStable transfers NEVER fail, so _tryTransfer (PhlimboV3.sol:471) never returns false, so unclaimablePromoOf/totalUnclaimableOf (:479-480) are NEVER written. Any bank invariant asserted against that harness passes VACUOUSLY (0 == 0). The run-09 harnesses use MockBlocklistToken/MBlockToken and seed a NON-EMPTY bank into every run, with a require() tripwire that aborts the campaign if the bank is empty. That tripwire fired on the first Medusa attempt and caught exactly this vacuity.

invariants.name: invariant_INVM1_cursor_never_pinned / _never_regresses / _in_range
invariants.statement: A successful migrate(maxIterations > 0) always advances migrateIterator (or completes to -1); the cursor never regresses (story-026 / audit-08 V3-M-04 fix)
invariants.coverage: Every migrate call observed advanced the cursor (migrateCalls == advancingMigrates in all sampled runs); completions and skipCurrent both exercised. The campaign actively manufactured reverting positions to try to pin the cursor: V3 un-wired ('Not authorized' inside migrateOne), V2 un-wired, V3 paused (stake reverts), V2 paused (withdraw reverts), dust-band positions (:194-200), fully-exited positions (:193), and blocked reward recipients (_forward banking path). The try/catch at :202-211 absorbed all of them and fell through.
invariants.knownScopeLimit: Per profile INV-M-1 caveat: try/catch absorbs REVERTS, not gas exhaustion. An OOG migrateOne under the 63/64 rule is NOT reachable by this campaign and remains a documented residual (skipCurrent :284 is the owner backstop). Recorded as a coverage gap with zero weight, not as a clean bill.
